title: Equality of microstates and nonmicrostates free entropy
exact_target: For every bounded finite self-adjoint tuple in a tracial von Neumann algebra for which both entropies are finite, must classical microstates free entropy $\chi $, with its original operator-norm cutoff and limsup convention, equal nonmicrostates free entropy $\chi *$?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
